<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">   * past --radius-max (16px): larger corners read as pills on controls and break nested parts. 4xl and 5xl stay as</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  --radius-2xs: min(calc(var(--radius) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">*</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">.25</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">), var(--radius-max));</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  --radius-md: min(calc(var(--radius) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">*</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">.75</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">), var(--radius-max));</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Radius presets: `data-radius` on &#x3C;html> swaps the one base value every radius token multiplies</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * (default, no attribute, is 0.5rem). A custom value is set inline as `--radius` on &#x3C;html> (0 to 1rem); every</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * token stops at --radius-max (16px), so a larger value only makes controls rounder up to that cap.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">html</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">data-radius</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"none"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">] {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">html</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">[</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">data-radius</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">"sm"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">] {</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Accent presets: `data-accent` on &#x3C;html> swaps the eight accent roles (default, no attribute, is blue).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Each preset reads the same steps of its own scale: solid 9, hover 10, active 11, subtle a3 / a4,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * border a6, ring a8 (a9 in dark). Neutral is the inverted black / white solid. The docs header</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * persists the pick in localStorage["accent"]; registry items theme-&#x3C;name> ship the same values.</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    width</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">10</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">px</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    height</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">10</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">px</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/* Thumb only appears while the pointer is over the area (sidebars, popups). */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> scrollbar-hover {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  scrollbar-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: transparent transparent;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    background-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">transparent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">:hover</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    scrollbar-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">var</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">--scrollbar</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">transparent</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    background-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">var</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">--scrollbar</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">:hover::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    background-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">var</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">--scrollbar-hover</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> scrollbar-none {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  scrollbar-width</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: none;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">::-webkit-scrollbar</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    display</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">none</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Rail layout: the window band and sidebar sit on `bg-shell`; the content is an inset panel</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * with a 0.5px hairline (one device pixel on Retina), a 1.5x radius and a 3px gap to the</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * window's right and bottom edges.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> shell-inset {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  background-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: var(--background);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  border: 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">.5px</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> solid var(--shell-border);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  border-radius</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: var(--radius-shell);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  margin-inline-end</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: 3px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  margin-bottom</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: 3px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/* Desktop shells: an area that drags the window, and controls inside it that stay clickable. No effect in a browser. */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> window-drag {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  -webkit-app-region: drag;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  user-select</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: none;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> window-no-drag {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  -webkit-app-region: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">no-drag</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Hairline on images and video: pure black (white in dark) at 10%, inset so it adds no size.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * A neutral edge, never a palette grey, so it reads the same on any surface behind the image.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> media-outline {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  outline: 1px solid oklch(0 0 0 / 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">.1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  outline-offset</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: -1px;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  &#x26;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">:is</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">.dark</span><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787"> *</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">    outline-color</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">oklch</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> / </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">0.1</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Icon stroke tier: line icons inside take 1.2x their style's stroke, to match semibold or bold text</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * beside them (rounded 1.75 -> 2.1, outline 1.6 -> 1.92). icon-regular resets it inside a bold area.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> icon-bold {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  --icon-stroke-scale: 1.2;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> icon-regular {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  --icon-stroke-scale: 1;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/* Sticky top edge for a shell-inset panel that scrolls with the page (docs shell). */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@utility</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> shell-cap {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  border-top-left-radius</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: var(--radius-shell);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  border-top-right-radius</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: var(--radius-shell);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/*</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * ───────────── Concentric radii: frame-* + rounded-inner ─────────────</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * A rounded element inside a rounded, padded container must use the container's radius minus</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * the inset (inner = outer − padding − border), or the corners visibly drift apart.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Instead of computing that by hand in every component:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   &#x3C;div class="frame-2xl frame-p-1">         radius 2xl (12px), padding 4px</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *     &#x3C;button class="rounded-inner">…&#x3C;/button>   → 12 − 4 = 8px</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   &#x3C;/div></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   frame-{sm…5xl|shell|[len]}  the container: sets its border-radius and publishes the radius</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *                               its children should use (--frame-inner-1).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   frame-p-{n|[len]}           padding on all sides AND the inset used in the calculation.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   frame-inset-{n|[len]}       only the inset (when the gap comes from px/py, a gap, or a</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *                               wrapper): the frame's own padding is left alone.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   frame-border                add the frame's 1px border to the inset.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   rounded-inner               a child: border-radius = frame radius − inset (min 2px, never above the frame).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   rounded-{t,b,s,e}-inner     the same for one side (first/last rows, segmented ends).</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   frame-inner                 a child that is itself a padded frame (second level): gets</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *                               rounded-inner and publishes its own inner radius, so its</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *                               children use rounded-inner too. Combine with frame-p-*.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Two levels deep (frame → frame-inner → rounded-inner) is supported; beyond that, compute the</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * value explicitly. `frame-xl` on an element that has no children to fit is just `rounded-xl`.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Every element resets the inputs (in the base layer, under every utility), so a frame never picks up</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * an ancestor's padding. A plain rule rather than @property, so reinstalling the theme stays idempotent.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">@layer</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> base {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#116329;--shiki-dark:#7EE787">  *</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">::before</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">::after</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">    --frame-r</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">px</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">    --frame-p</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#CF222E;--shiki-dark:#FF7B72">px</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">;</span></span>
